title: CoinRadar
tagline: Get a complete real time token overview and risk assessment from over 1.6 Million tokens scanned by our radar and become an intelligent investor.
description:
Risk Mitigation: Investors can confidently navigate the crypto space with a proactive approach to risk management, thanks to the tool's real-time simulation and analysis.

Informed Decision-Making: Access to comprehensive data ensures that users can make informed decisions based on a holistic understanding of a token's characteristics and associated risks.

Security: The Honeypot Detector serves as a security layer, protecting investors from fraudulent projects and potential financial pitfalls.

The Honeypot Detector revolutionizes the way investors engage with decentralized finance, offering a powerful and user-friendly solution to navigate the complexities of the crypto landscape.

how_its_made: We ran into a lot of challenges, initally it was trying to get all the available blockchain and running our own indexer for fetching token details. Then we started getting into trouble with understanding the accounts that were available holding funds in the present block number. Later we solved this by writing our own module to recheck with existing data. Understanding how to algorithmize the honeypot was something we had an issue with due to lot of parameters involving like what range of buy or sell should it.
